definitions.explanation: A room with a wooden or carpeted floor, as opposed to a Japanese-style room with tatami mats. Common in modern Japanese houses and apartments.

examples.japanese: {洋間|ようま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ソファ→ソファ：04485_sofa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いた→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: I put a sofa in the Western-style room.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{洋間|ようま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This house has one Japanese-style room and two Western-style rooms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新築|しんちく}→新築：06567_shinchiku⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{洋間|ようま}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧で、⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Recently built apartments often have only Western-style rooms and no Japanese-style rooms.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧: Japanese-style room (with tatami mats)
- ⟦{洋室|ようしつ}→洋室：15741_youshitsu⟧: Western-style room (synonym; more commonly used in real estate listings)

USAGE:
{洋間|ようま} and ⟦{洋室|ようしつ}→洋室：15741_youshitsu⟧ are largely interchangeable. ⟦{洋室|ようしつ}→洋室：15741_youshitsu⟧ is more common in formal contexts like apartment listings. A {洋間|ようま} typically has flooring (⟦フローリング→フローリング：11125_furooringu⟧) or carpet, with chairs and tables rather than sitting on the floor.
